# exp/waterline — eye-check gate (F-format)

**Method.** Marks generated by `build.py` (elevation proportions from the
murti codex); battery rendered through the Phase-0 pipeline, inspected
full-size.

| # | Check | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hero mark on ivory — four elements, whitespace | PASS — modern-gallery minimal; dome/cup weave clean at full size |
| 2 | Favicon 16/24/32/48, light + dark | PASS — dot + arc + line stack legible at 16 px on both themes |
| 3 | Learnability strip | PASS — the four-step build reads without caption |
| 4 | Divider glyph | PASS — immediately usable as the system's <hr>; quiet, on-grammar |
| 5 | Indigo / charcoal grounds | PASS — ivory strokes + gold points carry |
| 6 | Poster sim | PASS — the strongest "modern temple" register of the four batteries |
| 7 | 6 cm mono | PASS — survives single colour; drop keeps its gap |
| 8 | Misreading risk (sunrise / spa adjacency) | WATCH — real without context; rule: first-exposure surfaces pair the mark with the wordmark; the gold drop must never be recoloured |
| 9 | Circle-crop avatar | PASS-minus — horizontal composition sits wide in a circle; acceptable, not ideal (A/B crop better) |
| 10 | "12-ness" | KNOWN LIMIT — this direction carries the axis, not the wheel; if picked alone, the 12/24 numbers live only in layout grid + ceremonial surfaces |

**Net:** the probe succeeds — cheap, distinctive, structurally sound at all
battery stations; carries a real genericity risk that governance (not
geometry) must manage.
